text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Even in this mood, I managed to hit the
board
somehow.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What, you're saying I have this super
solid
foundation or whatever?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Well, a whole lot of good it's done me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Wow, why didn't I think of that? Look, if
you
actually want me to be more
optimistic or
whatever...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I know... I know I need to better my
attitude.
